name: iteration10_coherent_core_refined_threshold_sampling
scope: Construct the normalized coherent total-photon truncated pure core, apply the original correlated Gaussian displacement channel, and sample threshold outcomes by a rank-one local POVM refinement. This is a finite Fock prototype, not MPS or a universal efficient GBS algorithm.

reference.method: analytic Gaussian tilt and finite Wick moments, followed by complete threshold Mobius inversion; no Monte Carlo law estimation
reference.reference_resource_rejection: save and report; never replace a selected input

native.arithmetic: complex long double in the new sampler; retained baseline retains its unchanged arithmetic
native.hidden_channel_policy: sample all K+1 projective channels, split parallel channel with positive Poisson CDF/tail; keep all remaining total N<=K occupations including odd sectors
native.likelihood: no claim that a latent path probability is the marginal binary output probability
native.failure: stop and preserve partial results; no retry, refill, or failed-case replacement

timing.primary_cost: native setup plus sampling, including basis/state construction, correlated displacement draws, conditional state contractions, RNG and sample allocation; separately report wrapper/input/output costs
timing.statistic: median of the three predetermined repetitions per case/method/sample-count; quality-cost comparisons only when both full laws were evaluated

resource_boundary.expectation: reject by basis resource cap before allocation; this is not a numerical failure or a replacement timing input

claims.formal_theorem: In ideal arithmetic, same displacement channel and measurement give TV <= sqrt(core photon tail); finite arithmetic and failure need their own budget
